name: Penny Ann's Country Fried Steak with Country Gravy (Warning)
whyItWorks: Tenderized cube steak battered in seasoned flour, deep-fried in shortening, and smothered in sausage country gravy. The combination of deep fryer lipids and sausage fat triggers violent gut contractions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fat & Grease Warning: Strictly avoid during flares. Choose grilled lean ham or soft scrambled eggs instead.
